title: Sillustani Burial Towers Tour from Puno
short_description: Discover the impressive Sillustani burial towers and Umayo Lagoon on a half-day trip from Puno filled with history, mystery and Altiplano scenery.
long_description: Explore the enigmatic archaeological complex of Sillustani, one of the most important burial sites in the Peruvian Altiplano. About 35 minutes from Puno, discover its monumental burial towers and the peaceful landscape of Umayo Lagoon. An ideal experience for travelers interested in archaeology, Andean culture, history and photography.

days.title: Day 1: Puno – Sillustani – Umayo Lagoon – Puno
days.text: Depart Puno for the Sillustani archaeological complex, about 35 minutes away. Walk among its monumental burial towers as your guide explains their history, architecture and ceremonial role. Enjoy panoramic views of Umayo Lagoon and time for photographs before returning to Puno.
